<!-- All news items below this line -->{{Current events|year=2003|month=04|day=29|content=
* The [[World Health Organization]] lifts the [[severe acute respiratory syndrome|SARS]] travel warning for [[Toronto]].
* Leaders of member countries of [[ASEAN]] and the [[Premier of the People's Republic of China]] held an emergency summit in [[Bangkok]], [[Thailand]] in order to address the [[severe acute respiratory syndrome|SARS]] problem. Among the decisions made were the setting-up of a ministerial-level task force and uniform pre-departure health screening in airports.
* [[Israel]]i forces assassinate three [[Palestinian people|Palestinian]] militants in [[Gaza City|Gaza]], including [[Nidal Salamah]], a leader of the [[Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine]].  The action prompts accusations that Israel is trying to sabotage the Palestinian government's attempts to transform itself.
* [[Mahmoud Abbas]] is confirmed as the first [[Palestinian Authority]] [[prime minister]] after winning a vote of confidence from the Palestinian legislature.
* The United States announces that it will be reducing its military presence in [[Saudi Arabia]] to a handful of advisors.
* [[Lynn Htun]], suspected of being the head of the [[Fluffi Bunni]] computer [[white hat (computer security)|cracker]] ring, is arrested in London.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.globeandmail.com/servlet/story/RTGAM.20030429.wfluf429/BNStory/Technology |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-15 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080520113908/http://www.globeandmail.com/servlet/story/RTGAM.20030429.wfluf429/BNStory/Technology |archive-date=2008-05-20 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* [[Quebec]] premier-elect [[Jean Charest]] is sworn in and names his cabinet.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.globeandmail.com/servlet/story/RTGAM.20030429.wchar429/BNStory/National |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-15 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080521160210/http://www.globeandmail.com/servlet/story/RTGAM.20030429.wchar429/BNStory/National |archive-date=2008-05-21 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
